newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Investors say confidence in Nicaragua has grown.
newsitem.headline: Investors say confidence in Nicaragua has grown.

text.p: Foreigners have grown more confident about investing in Nicaragua despite continued nervousness over the country's political situation, U.S. and Latin American investors said at a conference on Friday.
"Confidence for foreign investors is optimum, and I would say that these are ripe times," said Waldo Castro, director of the Latin America Hemisphere Chamber of Commerce and Industry Congress.

Business representatives from the congress, who were visiting the Nicaragua for three days, said they had "a very favorable impression" of the country, identifying opportunities in construction, tourism, cattle and agriculture.
Still, some business leaders expressed reservations over Nicaragua's "fragile" political situation, years after the country emerged from a protracted civil war that devastated the economy.
"There continues to be a some caution from international investors who believe more time needs to pass for political stability," Chamber President Gabriel Pascual told Reuters.
